notes: Robots: cotidianul.ro/robots.txt 200, permissive (only /wp-admin/, /trackback/, /xmlrpc.php, /feed/, /wp-json/ disallowed) and it advertises /sitemaps/sitemap-posts-index.xml, sitemap-news.xml, sitemap-categories.xml, sitemap-authors.xml. ROUTE: (1) the posts index is a sitemapindex of monthly flat urlsets /sitemaps/sitemap-posts-YYYY-MM.xml; the two files 2026-09 and 2026-10 (200, 2060 and 1878 <url> entries) cover the whole 2026-09-25..10-25 window with no recursion, 326 + 1784 in-window URLs. <lastmod> is the publish instant in Romania local time (+03:00, +02:00 after the 2026-10-25 DST flip) and equals the article JSON-LD datePublished to the second (checked on 4 samples). (2) PROBLEM FOUND: the September file was last built 2026-09-30T04:32+03:00 (its lastmod in the index), so it holds only 1 post of 2026-09-30 while the site really published ~89 that day -> a sitemap-only list gives 2 URLs on the checked day. Closed alternatives: /?rest_route=/wp/v2/posts (the pretty /wp-json/ is robots-disallowed, the query form is 403 behind the WAF), /feed/ robots-disallowed. OPEN route used as top-up: the site's own WordPress date archive /2026/09/30/ -> 200, h1 'Zi: 30 septembrie 2026', 26 <article> blocks per page, paginated /page/2/ /page/3/ /page/4/ all 200 (26/26/26/10 post links) = 88 posts for that day. Only the anchor with class="entry-title" is taken: the first attempt took the first href in each <article> block and picked up category links (/articole/actualitate/ ...), which have no datePublished and would fail the article re-fetch; filtered now by entry-title plus a /articole/ path reject. The script tops up ANY window day whose sitemap count is below 20, dated with the archive's own day, then writes data/urls_custom/cotidianul-ro.tsv sorted by date. RESULT: 2198 unique URLs, 31/31 days covered, 09-30=89, 10-10=41, 10-20=79, min 38 (09-27); 7 requests, ~4 s. Verified by re-fetching 15 articles spread over 09-25, 09-30, 10-10, 10-20, 10-25: all 200, 6.1k-29.2k characters of text, JSON-LD datePublished identical to the listed date (Romanian local date; a post published 00:00-02:59 local would land on the previous UTC day, still within the 1-day tolerance). No low_volume flag needed.
